claim: The module docstring title is missing a word: it reads "# Modules over presheaves commutative rings".
requested_change: Change the title line to "# Modules over presheaves of commutative rings".
evidence: diff.patch line 11 of the new file: `# Modules over presheaves commutative rings`. Every other docstring in the file says "presheaf/presheaves of commutative rings".

claim: `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` duplicates the existing `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat`, which the PR description itself cites as the precedent. Both have body `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀ F (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)`, so the library ends up with two names for one functor.
requested_change: Keep one name. Deprecate `PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat` in favour of `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀` with `@[deprecated (since := "2026-..")] alias`, and move its only use, `instance : (pushforward₀OfCommRingCat F R).Monoidal` in `PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean`, to the new name.
evidence: file_read target/Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Pushforward.lean:71-74 shows `abbrev pushforward₀OfCommRingCat (R : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) : PresheafOfModules.{v} (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _) ⥤ PresheafOfModules.{v} ((F.op ⋙ R) ⋙ forget₂ _ _) := pushforward₀ F (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)`. content_search found its only use at PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean:33. lean_verify_edit (declaration PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.pushforward₀ plus an example) compiled `example : pushforward₀.{v} F R = PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat.{v} F R := by with_reducible rfl`, so the two are reducibly equal.

claim: `mkHom` does not follow the CategoryTheory name for a morphism constructor built from components, which is `homMk` (e.g. `ComposableArrows.homMk (app) (w)`, `Over.homMk`, `Arrow.homMk`, `ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.homMk`).
evidence: content_search for `^(noncomputable )?(abbrev|def) (mkHom|homMk)` under target/Mathlib/CategoryTheory found `homMk` in 19 files (FintypeCat, Elements, Over/Under, Arrow, StructuredArrow, ComposableArrows, FullSubcategory, MonoOver, Grp, CommMon, LaxMonoidalFunctor, ...) and `mkHom` in 4 (Equivalence, InducedBicategory, Span, Products). naming_norm returned subject_unresolved, so this is a count by hand. `PresheafOfModules.homMk` (Presheaf.lean:220) exists with a different signature (from a morphism of underlying abelian presheaves), so the rename creates a same-named sibling with different arguments; a docstring note would cover that. lean_verify_edit with the renamed `homMk` compiled.

claim: The `naturality` argument of `mkHom` has no `:= by cat_disch` default. The field it fills, `PresheafOfModules.Hom.naturality`, has that autoParam, and so does the sibling `isoMk` in this file, so callers must always prove naturality by hand.
requested_change: Give `naturality` the default `:= by cat_disch`, i.e. `(naturality : ∀ {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y), M₁.map f ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (R.map f).hom).map (app Y) = app X ≫ M₂.map f := by cat_disch)`.
evidence: Presheaf.lean:98-100: `naturality {X Y : Cᵒᵖ} (f : X ⟶ Y) : ... := by cat_disch`. In the PR, `isoMk` keeps `:= by cat_disch` but `mkHom` does not. lean_verify_edit replaced mkHom with the autoParam version plus `example {M : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.{v} R} : M ⟶ M := homMk (fun X ↦ 𝟙 _)`, where the default discharges naturality: success.

claim: `mk` drops the `:= by cat_disch` defaults that the `PresheafOfModules` structure fields `map_id` and `map_comp` have, so this constructor is less convenient than the anonymous-constructor form it wraps.
requested_change: Add `:= by cat_disch` as the default for both the `map_id` and the `map_comp` arguments of `mk`.
evidence: Presheaf.lean:48-55: both `map_id` and `map_comp` end in `:= by cat_disch`. lean_verify_edit replaced `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.mk` with both arguments given `:= by cat_disch` defaults: success.

claim: The file imports `Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Pullback`, but the base abbrev `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` and the whole `Basic` section (mk/obj/map/mkHom/isoMk/unit/restrictScalars) need only `Presheaf.ChangeOfRings`. Because of this, the files that should adopt the abbrev cannot use it: `Pushforward.lean` (which `Pullback` imports, so using it there would be an import cycle), `Monoidal.lean`, `PushforwardZeroMonoidal.lean`, `Differentials/Presheaf.lean` and `Stalk.lean` all spell out `PresheafOfModules (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)`. The PR's stated goal is a namespace that the dozen comm-ring abbrevs in open PRs can move into.
requested_change: Split the file. Define `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing` and the `Basic` section in a low file that imports only `Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.ChangeOfRings` (or in `Presheaf/ChangeOfRings.lean` itself). Put `pushforward₀`/`pushforward` next to `PresheafOfModules.pushforward` in `Pushforward.lean`, and `pullback`/`pullbackPushforwardAdjunction` in `Pullback.lean`.
evidence: lean_verify_edit (line mode, lines 8-120) replaced the import with `public import Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.ChangeOfRings` and kept the abbrev plus the full Basic section unchanged: success. Pullback.lean:8-11 imports Generator, Pushforward, Adjunction.PartialAdjoint and Adjunction.CompositionIso. content_search for `PresheafOfModules ... (R ⋙ forget₂` found uses in Presheaf.lean:64, Stalk.lean:187, Pushforward.lean:72, Monoidal.lean:41/63/105/125 and Differentials/Presheaf.lean:51/97-108.

claim: `unit` rebinds `(R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})` explicitly, shadowing the section variable `{R : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}}` declared in the same `Basic` section. Mathlib's idiom for making a section variable explicit in one declaration is `variable (R) in`, as `PresheafOfModules.unit` itself does (Presheaf.lean:282-303).
requested_change: Delete the binder and precede the declaration with `variable (R) in`: `variable (R) in /-- ... -/ noncomputable abbrev unit : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.{u} R := PresheafOfModules.unit (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _)`.
evidence: lean_verify_edit (lines 76-79 replaced by `variable (R) in` plus the docstring and `noncomputable abbrev unit : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.{u} R := ...`, together with an example `unit R = PresheafOfModules.unit (R ⋙ forget₂ _ _) := rfl`): success, and R is still explicit.

claim: For `M : PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing R`, `M.map f` now elaborates to the new head `PresheafOfModulesOfCommRing.map`, so `rw` with the existing API (`PresheafOfModules.map_id`, `PresheafOfModules.map_comp`, and likewise `Hom.naturality`) no longer finds its pattern. `simp` and term-mode still work. The abbrev adds `map` without the basic rewrite lemmas that go with it.
requested_change: Next to `map`, add `lemma map_id (M) (X) : M.map (𝟙 X) = (ModuleCat.restrictScalarsId' (R.map (𝟙 X)).hom (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom (R.map_id X))).inv.app _ := PresheafOfModules.map_id M X` and a `@[reassoc] lemma map_comp`, stated with the new `map` and proved by `PresheafOfModules.map_comp M f g`, so that `rw [map_id]`/`rw [map_comp]` work on the new spelling.
evidence: lean_verify_edit with examples after `map`: `rw [PresheafOfModules.map_id]` fails with "Did not find an occurrence of the pattern PresheafOfModules.map ?self (𝟙 ?X) in the target expression M.map (𝟙 X) = ...", and `rw [PresheafOfModules.map_comp]` fails the same way. `by simp` and `PresheafOfModules.map_id M X` (term mode) succeed on the same goal. A second lean_verify_edit added the proposed `map_id` and `@[reassoc] map_comp`: both compile, and `rw [map_id]` closes the goal.
